plugins.label: ColorCorrectOFX
plugins.description:
Adjusts the saturation, contrast, gamma, gain and offset of an image.
The ranges of the shadows, midtones and highlights are controlled by the curves in the "Ranges" tab.
The Contrast adjustment works using the formula: Output = (Input/0.18)^Contrast*0.18.

See also:
- http://opticalenquiry.com/nuke

plugins.label: GradeOFX
plugins.description:
Modify the tonal spread of an image from the white and black points.
This node can also be used to match colors of 2 images: The darkest and lightest points of the target image are converted to black and white using the blackpoint and whitepoint values. These 2 values are then moved to new values us

plugins.label: MirrorOFX
plugins.description:
Flip (vertical mirror) or flop (horizontal mirror) an image. Interlaced video can not be flipped.
This plugin does not concatenate transforms.

plugins.label: Quantize
plugins.description:
Reduce the number of color levels per channel.
See also: https://web.archive.org/web/20210728012057/http://opticalenquiry.com/nuke/index.php?title=Color_Operation

plugins.label: Rand
plugins.description: Generate a random field of noise. The field does not resample if you change the resolution or density (you can animate the density without pixels randomly changing).

plugins.label: SaturationOFX
plugins.description:
Modify the color saturation of an image.
See also: https://web.archive.org/web/20220627030455/http://www.opticalenquiry.com/nuke/index.php?title=Saturation

plugins.label: Cartoon
plugins.description: Cartoonify video, do a form of edge detect

plugins.label: colorize
plugins.description: Colorizes image to selected hue, saturation and lightness

plugins.label: emboss
plugins.description: Creates embossed relief image of source image

plugins.label: Nervous
plugins.description: flushes frames in time in a nervous way

plugins.label: Vertigo
plugins.description: alpha blending with zoomed and rotated images

plugins.label: Vignette
plugins.description: Lens vignetting effect, applies natural vignetting

ofx:net.sf.openfx.ColorCorrectPlugin.name: luminanceMath
ofx:net.sf.openfx.ColorCorrectPlugin.label: Luminance Math
ofx:net.sf.openfx.ColorCorrectPlugin.hint:
Formula used to compute luminance from RGB values (used for saturation adjustments).

Rec. 709: Use Rec. 709 (0.2126r + 0.7152g + 0.0722b).
Rec. 2020: Use Rec. 2020 (0.2627r + 0.6780g + 0.0593b).
ACES AP0: Use ACES AP0 (0.3439664498r + 0.7281660966g + -0.0721325464b).
ACES AP1: Use ACES AP1 (0.2722287168r +  0.6740817658g +  0.0536895174b).
CCIR 601: Use CCIR 601 (0.2989r + 0.5866g + 0.1145b).
Average: Use average of r, g, b.
Max: Use max or r, g, b.

None: No dithering (posterize), creating abrupt changes.
Ordered (Bayer 2x2): Ordered dithering using a 2x2 Bayer matrix.
Ordered (Bayer 4x4): Ordered dithering using a 4x4 Bayer matrix.

Ordered (void-and-cluster 25x25): Ordered dithering using a void-and-cluster 25x25 matrix.
